title: Limit signals
description: How bin/ledger.py reads a live limit (F2c A1), as data: which answer headers carry the wait (retry_after: the seconds or date a server asks the caller to wait; reset: when a quota resets, as seconds, a duration like 1m30s, an epoch or an ISO time; the longest wins), how long a limit with no stated time lasts (default_wait_seconds), the longest wait any header can set (max_wait_seconds), and, per CLI id (a connection's `cli`), the texts of its limit errors (cli_patterns: plain substrings) and the regular expressions that read its usage output (cli_usage: one named group `pct`, the percent of the plan used). A CLI with no usage pattern has no plan share. The classification of an API answer as a limit is the wire shape's `errors` (protocols.json), not this file.

plan_share_max_age_seconds.description: A plan share recorded longer ago than this is not shown.

plan_share_limit.description: A cli-login link whose plan share (a fraction) is at or above this counts as at its limit: the resolver leaves it (cooldown).

min_wait_seconds.description: The shortest wait a limit is observed for, whatever a header says.

limit_error_plan_share.description: The plan share a CLI's limit error stands for (1 = the whole plan).

day_reset.description: The clock a daily cap resets on: exactly one of utc_offset_minutes (a fixed offset from UTC) or zone (a zone name the standard library knows); the day runs from midnight to midnight there.

limit_triggers.description: Which answer classes (the wire shape's errors) are a limit, and how the wait is found: the sources in order, the first that gives a time wins (retry_after, reset_header, day_reset: the next reset of the daily clock, default: default_wait_seconds). A class not listed is no limit.

outcome_classes.description: What each outcome word of a usage record means: counts_as_call (it counts against a daily cap) and is_error (an error in reports and an error span). A word not listed counts as a call and as an error.

billing.description: How a connection type is billed: plan (no cost, a plan share) or metered (priced). A type not listed is metered.

cache_hit_rate.description: The cache hit rate is the sum of the numerator token types over the sum of the denominator token types (names of the usage schema's tokens).

duration_units.description: The duration units of a reset header (1m30s) and their length in seconds.

epoch_min_seconds.description: A plain number of seconds above this in a reset header is an epoch time, not a wait.

field_limits.description: The most characters kept of the holder name of a refused hold and of the reason of an observed limit.
